summary: Frontend visual redesign of Heimdall app tested via web preview at mobile viewport 390x844. All primary flows work: language selection -> login -> Home renders with new cream/emerald branding, reward banner (205 HUESOS trophy + gold bone), hero AI analysis banner with vet-mascot illustration, 6 quick access cards, all Home sub-sections (Actividad de salud, diario emocional, Progreso semanal, HANI Passport, Biblioteca de ejercicios, promo chat) render correctly. All 5 bottom tabs navigate correctly (Inicio, Salud, Educación, Chat, Perfil) with central mascot avatar. Salud shows new Salud 360° dark-green chaleco banner. Educación renders 'Sesión de Hoy' properly. Dark mode toggle works (moon icon in header) - switches to dark emerald palette and back with legible text. Chat AI end-to-end verified in initial run (message + AI response received).

ui_bugs.component: TouchableOpacity across app/(tabs)/index.tsx (and likely other RN components)
ui_bugs.issue: data-testid props are NOT being forwarded to the DOM in the React Native Web build. Zero elements with [data-testid] were found in the rendered DOM despite 12 declarations in index.tsx (reward-banner, ai-analysis-banner, quick-access-*, theme-toggle-btn, health-activity-section, etc). React Native Web expects the standard `testID` prop (which it converts to `data-testid` on web) - using JSX `data-testid` directly on RN Pressable/TouchableOpacity/View does not pass through.

action_items: Replace all `data-testid="..."` occurrences on React Native components (TouchableOpacity, Pressable, View, Text, etc) with `testID="..."`. RN Web automatically converts testID -> data-testid on web output. This is required so future automated tests can locate reward-banner / ai-analysis-banner / quick-access-* / theme-toggle-btn per the review spec.
Verify same fix applied in _layout.tsx tab bar and any other screens that declare data-testid on RN elements.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx uses `data-testid` as a JSX prop on RN components - React Native Web won't forward this. Use the RN standard `testID` prop instead so it becomes data-testid in the web DOM.
aria-label 'Toggle theme' works as a fallback selector for the theme button - good, but ideally replace with testID for consistency.
Home screen file appears large (>350 lines with big createStyles). Consider extracting section components for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: Functional 100% (all flows work); testability 0% for the declared data-testids

context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual redesign verified visually and via navigation. Session persists in localStorage on the preview URL - after first login you may land directly on Home (skip language/login). Note that data-testid attrs are currently missing in DOM - use text or aria-label ('Toggle theme') selectors until main agent renames data-testid -> testID.
